title: Junior Backend Developer (Python)
description: Build and maintain REST APIs using Python and FastAPI. Design SQL schemas, write unit tests, collaborate with the frontend team and use Git and Docker in an Agile environment.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Create responsive user interfaces with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Consume REST APIs, ensure cross-browser compatibility and accessibility. React or TypeScript experience is a plus.

title: Data Scientist
description: Develop machine learning models for prediction and NLP. Clean and analyze data with Pandas and NumPy, train models with scikit-learn and PyTorch, and present findings to stakeholders.

title: AI Engineer – LLM Applications
description: Build LLM-powered applications with retrieval-augmented generation and AI agents. Integrate vector search, design prompts, expose services through Python APIs and deploy with Docker.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Own features end-to-end: Python backend, SQL databases, and a JavaScript frontend. Write clean, tested code and deploy through CI/CD pipelines.

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyze business data using SQL and Python, build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau and communicate insights to management.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate infrastructure and deployments on AWS. Manage Docker and Kubernetes clusters, maintain CI/CD pipelines and monitor production systems on Linux.

title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Work alongside senior engineers on real features. Learn code review, Git workflow and testing. Basic Python or Java and data structures knowledge required.
